_comment: RFC-001 §3: the studio's RULES as first-class data. The geometry contract that keeps levels AI-completable-by-construction (per archetype), the judge thresholds, and the movement envelope the contracts assume. Read by tools/level-lint (the cheap static gate that runs before the expensive browser gate) and quotable by docs/agents. Pixels unless noted.

movement._: what the Studio.Platformer tune actually delivers — the envelope every geometry rule is derived from

runner._: left-to-right floor games (Ember). Floor is a ground[] of material slabs; lava/deadly is a GAP in walkable ground.

vertical._: climb-to-the-top games (clouds). World is platforms + a waypoint chain; the void/storm below is deadly. Every consecutive chain hop must be inside the movement envelope OR powered by a declared mechanic (updraft/spring/mover).

shooter._: vertical space shooter (Starlance). The deadly thing is the sweeping-gap bullet curtain; survivability is GUARANTEED when the live gap is always a safe column the autopilot can sit in.
shooter.curtainBound: sweepSpeed*fallTime < gapW/2 - shipHalf - 6 ; sweepSpeed = amp*2PI/period ; fallTime = shipY(470)/bulletSpeed

rts._: car lane-push RTS (Roadwar). Garage (you, bottom) vs fortress (top) across 3 lanes; you spend auto-income SCRAP to BUILD cars that drive up and brawl. WINNABLE-BY-CONSTRUCTION: the autopilot goes all-in on the rally lane with autoBuild, so two static facts guarantee a 0-death win.
rts.winBound: ACCUMULATION: income/autoBuild.cost > fortressTurret.dmg/(fortressTurretCd*autoBuild.hp) — the player adds rally units faster than the fortress turret removes them, so the deathball grows without bound and the (finite-schedule) fortress falls. SIDE-LEAK: a leaked off-rally scout reaches the base and is shot at distance-0 every garageTurretCd, dying after ceil(hp/dmg) shots having landed floor(killTime/scout.cd) attacks; the CUMULATIVE chip of all side scouts must stay under garageLeakBudgetFrac*garageHp.
